title: mentha aquatica var. brachystachya
intro: Mentha aquatica var. brachystachya, commonly known as dwarf water mint, is a variety of the water mint plant. It is known for its small leaves and is often used in herbal medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to alleviate digestive issues, reduce fever, and soothe respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Mentha aquatica var. brachystachya include menthone, menthol, and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use in traditional medicine.
